doc.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Becoming a record producer
summary: Mandel says his producing career blossomed in the 1980s, when he could demand control as part of the arranging package, wanting to oversee a record from conception to mastering.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: So you did that, you did part of an album with Diane Schuur, some of those arrangements.
Yeah, I just done a bunch of stuff.
Did produce that, I’ve produced all these albums you’re speaking of too.
Right, so your producing career kind of blossomed in the 80s right?
Yes, it did. I’ve wanted to produce records for twenty years and it’s very hard to get producing work, for somebody like me.
How did you make it happen?
What buttons did you push, who did you talk to, who opened some doors for you?
I had to wait until they wanted the arrangements badly enough.
If you want to know the truth and I just said, “Well, you gotta take the whole package.”
It’s nice that you had that kind of leverage.

Well when it happened I definitely took advantage of it and I really like, I love producing records and particularly ‘cause I just like to run my own store, I like to conceive the song jointly with the artist, or by myself and take it right up through the mastering to the time the thing hits the street and leaves the studio. I like to do the whole thing and it’s frustrating to me when I deliver it to someone else and they take it and do what they want with it. That’s the kind of feeling you often got in movies, too. I hear the finished product and I want to get it as close to the finished product that I heard as possible in my head, initially. That’s why producing is really part of it.
That’s one of the reasons Marion Evans got out of the music business isn’t it, because he got so bugged with things being out of his control that he was – mixes that he was unhappy with?
Probably, I just never discussed that with him, but I imagine that would’ve been one of the reasons. It’s you know, it’s something that happens to everyone and I can’t say that I enjoyed it one bit.
